nom: Clinique Clinique For Men Face Scrub

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report reduced clogged pores, control of oiliness, and improved appearance, with several calling it well suited to oily and acne-prone skin.
segments.dry: One reviewer notes the product leaves skin smooth without dryness, while another describes the formula itself as feeling dry when squeezed from the tube.
segments.combination: One reviewer states it works well for combination skin, softening and leaving a refreshing feeling.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin or a sensitive beard area report it can still be effective but describe it as harsh, tolerable only with limited scrubbing or reduced frequency.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s-60s and users citing anti-aging use report a younger-looking, brighter complexion after long-term use.

concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers describe fewer breakouts, easier removal of a new pimple, and clearer skin after starting use; one reviewer notes an initial breakout when first starting, attributed to purging.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers managing acne-prone or breakout-prone skin report the scrub keeps skin smooth with no new breakouts and helps deflake troubled skin; no dissent reported for this concern.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers with oily skin report visible control of oil and clearer pores; results are described as consistent across multiple oily-skin reviewers with no negative reports.
concerns.aging: Reviewers using the product long-term for anti-aging report looking noticeably younger and crediting it as part of a broader Clinique regimen; effects are attributed to routine rather than the scrub alone in some cases.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the scrub cuts through dirt and grit without causing redness or irritation even after sun exposure; another notes reduced irritation after shaving when used beforehand.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer notes the product is gentle enough for daily use without over-drying, while another reviewer found the texture itself dry when dispensed, suggesting inconsistent formula feel.
concerns.dehydration: A small number of reviewers state the scrub leaves skin smooth and not dry, but this is only briefly mentioned and not a major recurring theme.

aspects.libelle: Improves shave and reduces razor burn

extraits.texte: This is a great scrub. However, you should know that this is a very aggressive scrub. I only use this in my T-zone area, which is where I'm mostly oily at and I have large pores at. The scrub completely clears my pores and makes my skin feel so glossy and clean. However, I don't think I will use this on my beard. I have a sensitive beard, and I could only scrub the same area of my face 1-2 times with it because of how harsh it was exfoliating. This is a literal scrub with no lubricant other than water to mix with it. So while I would recommend this to others, I wouldn't recommend it to someone with sensitive skin unless they had a specific area to scrub.

This is the BEST scrub for oily skin. Has almost solid grit that actually makes you feel like you are removing dry, dull skin with little to no creaminess. A little goes a long way. I've tried many as a replacement and am never satisfied. This is the one!

extraits.titre: Perfect for loosening course facial hair
extraits.texte: I use this product before shaving and it really helps cut down on the drag from my razor. I have pretty course facial hair and before using this product would see a lot of irritation under my nose and on my cheeks after shaving. I've been using this product for about 2 months and see almost no irritation and experience a faster and smoother shave. I also use this scrub all over my face to help remove dry skin and black heads on and around my nose (I'm very prone to getting black heads). This product is very effective and still gentle enough for my sensitive skin for me to use 2-3 times a week.

I've been using Clinique for Men Face Scrub for over 20 years. I started using it in college to fight acne and I still love it too keep my face clean, bright, and now instead of acne I use it to fight signs of aging. I wish so many other products by other manufacturers still existed. Many other companies (Redken and Kiehl's) have discontinued or changed the formulas of their products, but Clinique has remained high quality and effective. I highly recommend this as an every other day exfoliating scrub.

I got this as a gift and love the way it leaves my skin feeling: as smooth as a baby's bottom. Especially when I combine it with Cliniques other anti aging products/moisturizers. I did break out when I first started using it, but I think that just tells you how much was built up in my pores. Love it and will continue to use it!

I use this product every other day. It's a great complexion enhancer. It also is great for combination skin. It softens and leaves a nice refreshing, minty feeling. I love the way this product makes my face feel! I use in conjuction with clinique mens face soap and scruffing lotion.
This product [...]was hard to squeeze out and felt dry. works okay, smells clean.
